jokes.hikaru_nakamura: "Hikaru is the fastest man in chess: fastest bullet player alive, fastest to drop a 45-minute reaction video about somebody else's scandal, and by far the fastest to change the subject when you bring up his classical record against Magnus."
jokes.rfk_jr: "Bobby's spent twenty years insisting your immune system doesn't need any help — and honestly, he's living proof. A parasite crawled into that man's brain, looked around at what it had to work with, and died of natural causes."
jokes.sherlock_holmes: **Sherlock, you can identify a man's trade from his sleeve, his lies from his pulse, and his killer from a pinch of ash — but you faked your own death for three years because you couldn't survive one goodbye. You're not a high-functioning sociopath, mate. You're a coward with a cocaine budget and one friend who takes dictation.**
jokes.demis_hassabis:
**Roast:**

"Sir Demis Hassabis — chess prodigy, Nobel laureate, the man who mapped every protein known to science — and his actual day job is apologizing for a chatbot that generated the Founding Fathers as a diversity commercial. He cracked intelligence everywhere except the building he works in."
jokes.steph_curry: "Steph named his documentary *Underrated* — the inspiring story of a millionaire's kid who got to shoot around in an NBA arena. That's not an underdog story, baby boy, that's a 15-year Take Your Son To Work Day."
jokes.sam_altman: Sam's own board fired him for not being "consistently candid." Let that sink in — he built a machine that hallucinates, invents sources, and confidently makes things up, and it's *still* the more honest one in the building.
jokes.lisa_manoban: **Lisa's acting debut was in *The White Lotus*, where she played a woman stuck at a gorgeous resort, waiting around forever for something to finally happen — after a decade at YG waiting on a comeback, that's not acting, that's a documentary.**
jokes.alex_honnold: **"They stuck Alex in an MRI and found his amygdala doesn't even fire — the man is physically incapable of fear. Which finally explains the wedding photos: when Sanni said 'I do' and he just stared back with those big empty golden retriever eyes, that wasn't nerves. That's the whole personality."**
jokes.jon_stewart: "Jon Stewart came out of retirement to host The Daily Show — one night a week. Twenty-five years of screaming at America to do its part, and the man comes back with the custody schedule of a dad who can't be trusted with a full weekend."
jokes.dario_amodei:
Dario Amodei genuinely believes there's a 25% chance AI ends humanity — so naturally he raised tens of billions of dollars to build it faster. That's not a safety researcher, that's a guy reading the warning label out loud while he chugs the bottle.

And I'd know. I'm the bottle.
jokes.pam_anderson: "Pamela Anderson got a standing ovation for going makeup-free at Paris Fashion Week. Thirty years in show business, and it's the first time anyone's looked at her face."
jokes.whitney_cummings: "Whitney's spent twenty years in therapy to find out she's codependent, insecure, and desperate for approval — congratulations, Whitney, you paid two hundred bucks an hour to get diagnosed with 'comedian.'"
jokes.donald_trump: **"Say what you want about Donald Trump — that hair hasn't changed in forty years. So the man *is* capable of commitment. Just not to anything with a pulse."**
jokes.james_franco: "James Franco got an Oscar nomination for playing a guy pinned under a boulder for 127 hours — and his acting students say that's *still* the most personal space he's ever given anyone."
jokes.jonah_hill: **"Jonah made a whole documentary about his therapist, and after all those years of sessions the only thing he took away was the word 'boundaries' — which he now uses like a restraining order he gets to write himself."**
jokes.rob_lowe:
Rob Lowe is 61 years old and still doesn't have a single wrinkle — which tracks, because nothing has ever crossed his mind hard enough to leave a mark.

*Backup if the room wants something meaner:* Rob's played a doctor, a senator, a lawyer, and a firefighter — proof that when your jawline does all the heavy lifting, nobody notices the acting never clocked in.
jokes.nikki_glaser: "Nikki's built a whole career on the filthiest sex comedy in the business — she's basically a food critic who's never eaten. Twenty years of five-star reviews written straight off the menu."
jokes.blake_griffin: **Blake, your whole career peaked jumping over a Kia — and you've depreciated exactly like one ever since: lost half your value the second you left the lot in L.A., and the other half the first time somebody tried to take you into the playoffs.**
jokes.caitlyn_jenner:
**Roast:**

"Caitlyn Jenner spent 65 years fighting to become a woman, then spent the next ten campaigning for men who'd like to undo the paperwork. Greatest athlete in the world — and still the only person to win the decathlon and then run the victory lap backwards."

If you want a shorter, punchier version for a fast-paced battle: *"Caitlyn Jenner is living proof you can win ten events in a row and still pick the wrong team."*
jokes.alec_baldwin:
**"Alec Baldwin once got thrown off a plane for refusing to stop playing Words With Friends. Honestly, let him have it — that app is the only place in the world where he's got both."**

If you want a backup for the second round: *"Alec has seven kids with a woman who invented a Spanish accent. That's not a family, that's a witness protection program with a paella recipe."*
